stem: The dot plots show the numbers of children’s books purchased by customers at two different bookstores on one day.
instruction: Which statement is supported by the information in the dot plots?

options.label: F
options.text: The mode of the data for Store 2 is greater than the mode of the data for Store 1.

options.label: G
options.text: The range of the data for Store 1 is greater than the range of the data for Store 2.

options.label: H
options.text: The mean of the data for Store 1 is greater than the mean of the data for Store 2.

options.label: J
options.text: The median of the data for Store 2 is greater than the median of the data for Store 1.

visual_elements: Dot plot Store 1 showing number of children's books purchased: 0 (2 dots), 1 (3 dots), 2 (5 dots), 3 (3 dots), 4 (1 dot), 5 (4 dots), 6 (2 dots)
Dot plot Store 2 showing number of children's books purchased: 0 (3 dots), 1 (6 dots), 2 (4 dots), 3 (2 dots), 4 (1 dot), 5 (2 dots), 6 (1 dot)
